arStrings.szText: "I've never fished before. How is it done?"
Never fished before...(scoffs) aiya... Bait goes on the hook. The hook goes into the water. Wait for a fish to bite the hook, then pull the fish up!
Terse, irritated. Can't believe this kid doesn't know how to fish.
(chuckles) Obviously there is more to it than this, heh! Proper form. Stillness. Intuition... Eh, but for you, start simple.
Cursing, terse, irritated. Can't believe this kid doesn't know how to fish.
